instruction: Candid outdoor photograph of three friends sitting on a green grassy lawn in a park. On the left, the Asian man in the red 'T' shirt (R3) sits gesturing with his left arm toward the center; the woman in the dark blue 'E' shirt (R4) sits in the middle laughing heartily; and the Black woman with an afro in the red 'A' shirt (R6) sits on the right smiling and gesturing with her hands. The bald man (R2) is absent from this shot. The scene is brightly lit by natural daylight with a soft-focus green background.
